verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes a JMAP API with API-token auth, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions a sandbox, test account tier, or non-production API endpoint. Logging in to multiple accounts would only be a user-side workaround, not a documented sandbox capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
